consistency: Version labels are selected explicitly. Equal before/after metadata and complete observed pages are consistency observations; this API provides no atomic history/content snapshot or immutable content attestation. No fallback to current node content.

nativeProcess.request: Original exact bodyText via saved programme and native process owner
nativeProcess.recovery: Reconcile the original dispatched operation; no replacement process start
nativeProcess.history: Original complete saved portfolio and exact process-instance ID from native reconciliation

sourceNumbers: Long and double mapped repository properties use exact decimal-text source values. Numeric JSON properties outside safe integral representation are rejected for mapping.
authoredExamples: All examples are authored implementation inputs, not native Alfresco/Flowable results or customer policies.
